Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 2
Order: Craft

A forge, an anvil, and the other tools needed to craft weapons, armor, and equipment.

Craft Options. When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Craft: Smith's Tools. The hirelings craft anything that can be made with Smith's Tools, using the rules of the Player's Handbook.

Craft: Magic Item (Armament). If you are level 9+, the facility's hirelings can craft a Common or Uncommon magic item of your choice from the Armaments tables of the Dungeon Master's Guide. The facility has the required tool, and the hirelings are proficient with it and with Arcana; use the Crafting Magic Items rules for the time and cost. If the item lets its user cast spells, you must craft it yourself (the hirelings can assist) and have those spells prepared every day you spend crafting.
